description: Returns the payment terms for https://horizonpulse.dev/api/agent/identity (base $0.01; USDC on Base or Polygon); this tool never runs the check or pays. Pay the 402 over HTTP with x402 v2: GET ?agentId=42&chain=base (chain: base, ethereum or polygon; one agent per call). ERC-8004 agent lookup: GET ?agentId=42&chain=base (or ethereum, polygon). Returns owner, agent wallet, registration URI, and reputation and validation summaries. On-chain reads only; registration files and IPFS are not fetched. Owner-written, untrusted data; not an endorsement. Not affiliated with the ERC-8004 authors. Bad input, unknown agent or RPC down: not charged; partial answers (partial:true) are charged. USDC on Base or Polygon. On USDC on Base, errors are not charged, apart from the exceptions noted on a route. On USDC on Solana, and RLUSD on the XRP Ledger, a refused or failed request may still be charged. On Polygon (native USDC), a request is settled only when it succeeds (HTTP status below 400).
